blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defending champion Criss Cross avoided VNS Laticrete’s upset bid, escaping with 25-19, 23-25, 22-25, 25-23, 15-13 to book a semifinals berth in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Sunday at the Filoil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. With the fifth set tied at 9, Jude Garcia scored three straight points to give the King Crunchers some breathing room, but Jau Umandal kept VNS within striking distance. Noel Kampton helped Criss Cross reach match point at 14-11. Setter Howard Guerra delivered back-to-back hits to cut the deficit to one before Kim Malabunga drilled a floating ball to […]...
